title: Bountiful Harvest
description: Dalhurst holds the autumn festival for the first time in three years; the last two were cancelled quietly. I want the finest of the valley on the temple table. A town that can hold its festival knows it survived.

objectives.description: Gather Fresh Wheat from Millbrook farms
Gather Autumn Apples from Elder Moor orchards
Gather Great Pumpkins from Thornfield fields
Gather Wild Honey from Crossroads area (defeat Giant Bees)
Deliver the harvest bounty to Priestess Elara

notes: Threat/consequence: none - a low-stakes quest, but the festival is now stated as a real, resumed event rather than an unheld abstraction, with the two skipped years as the implicit reason it matters. Giver motive: Elara wants it to succeed as a public sign the valley recovered.
